Live Bet & Get

Sportsbook Bet & Get - Live Bet & Get T&Cs (the “Terms and Conditions”)

 

Players who opt-in and place $50+ in cumulative cash wagers (min. -200 odds or longer) on any Live market(s) available on theScore Bet, will receive a $10 Bet Reset (defined below). Limit of one (1) Promotion Offer per Account, per Promotion Period.

 

The “Sportsbook Bet & Get - Live Bet & Get” (“Promotion”) is subject to the Promotional Terms and Conditions (“Promotion Terms”) of theScore Bet, can be viewed at theScore Bet > Legal > Promotional Terms and Conditions, and the following:

 

Description of Promotion

How It Works (short terms)

  • Opt-in Requirement: Opt-in is required.
  • Eligibility: Available to invited, registered players with an active and verified Account who receive the Promotion communication. Player invitation is based on previous play activity.
  • Eligible Games: Any Live market(s) available on theScore Bet
  • Eligible Wagers: Players must opt-in and place $50 or more in cumulative cash wager(s) on the Eligible Games during the Promotion Period.
  • Promotion Offer: Players who opt-in and place Eligible Wagers on the Eligible Game(s) during the Promotion Period will receive a $10 Bet Reset. The $10 Bet Reset must be used on any Parlay or Same Game Parlay (SGP) wager with 3+ legs and total odds of -200 or longer. Bet Reset may be used on any market(s) available on theScore Bet. Bonus Bet may be used on any markets available on theScore Bet. Limit one (1) Promotion Offer per Account, per Promotion Period.
    • Bonus Bets are bonus funds which may only be used on theScore Bet. Wagering with Bonus Bets makes no deductions from your cash balance. Wagers with Bonus Bets that settle as a WIN will only return the winnings to the player in withdrawable cash. For more information on Bonus Bets please see Sections 9 and 11 of the promotion’s full terms and conditions or visit our Bonus page.
    • Bet Resets are a bonus which may only be used on theScore Bet. Wagers with Bet Resets that settle as a LOSS will return a Bonus Bet equal to the maximum stated amount. For more information on Bet Resets, please see Sections 9 and 11 of the promotion’s full terms and conditions.
  • Promotion Period: The Promotion Periods are as follows:

Eligibility

  • Available to invited, registered players with an active and verified Account who receive the Promotion communication. Player invitation is based on previous play activity.
  • Eligibility restrictions apply. See ‘Eligibility’ section of the Promotion Terms for details.

 

Action Required

Players must opt-in and place Eligible Wagers on the Eligible Games to receive the Promotion Offer.

 

Claiming Promotion Offer

Bet Reset will be applied to the player’s Account immediately upon settlement of the Eligible Wagers(s), or in the event of technical difficulties within 72 hours and must be used within seven (7) days of receipt. Bonus Bets will be applied to the player’s Account within 72 hours and must be used within seven (7) days of receipt. Limit of one (1) Promotion Offer per Account.

 

Registration Procedures

To qualify for the Promotion, eligible individuals must have successfully registered for an Account on theScore Bet, as defined in the Terms of Use. Creating an Account on theScore Bet is free. By submitting your information and creating an Account, however, participants will be required to agree to the Sponsor’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Use. If you do not agree to the Sponsor’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Use, you cannot create an Account or participate in this Promotion. 

Limitations on Participation

In addition to the Eligibility requirements outlined in Section 3, the Sponsor reserves the right to refuse or otherwise restrict your eligibility to participate in any Promotion for any reason, in its sole discretion, including based on your wagering patterns or wagering history or if you failed to take advantage of any previous Promotion in good faith. This Promotion is void where prohibited by law.  Participants may be required to sign paperwork issued by Sponsor to receive any reward. For additional information on limitations on participation please see the Promotion Terms for details.

Wagering Requirements/Exclusions

Any Action Required (see Section 4) completed outside of the Promotion Period, or wagers that are settled using the live “Cash Out” feature are excluded from this Promotion. Unless otherwise specified by Sponsor, this Promotion may not be combined with any other promotional offer. Please see Section 11 for restrictions related to wagering the Promotion Offer.

Order of Funds Used for Wagering

  • Unless otherwise selected, the player’s cash balance will be used first to place wagers.
  • Bet Reset may be used on eligible markets and must be manually selected in your betslip window when placing a wager.
  • Bonus Bets may be used on eligible markets and must be manually selected in your betslip window when placing a wager.
  • For more information and restrictions on bonus funds, please visit our Bonus page.

 

Eligible Games

Any Live market(s) are available on theScore Bet with odds -200 or longer. Bonus Bets may be used on any market(s) available on theScore Bet.

Restrictions on Withdrawal

Bonus funds awarded are not transferable and cannot be substituted except in the Sponsor’s sole discretion. Bonus funds may only be used for wagering on your Account. Bonus funds may not be withdrawn from your Account until they have been converted to withdrawable cash. 

 

Bet Resets are eligible to be wagered in line with all the following requirements (“Bet Reset Requirements”) in order to be converted to withdrawable real cash:

  • Bet Reset funds can be redeemed on any market available on theScore Bet.
  • Bet Reset may only be redeemed on Parlay and Same Game Parlays.
  • Bet Reset may only be redeemed one at a time.
  • Loses will automatically convert stake into Bonus Bet upon bet settlement. 
  • Bet Reset cannot be used on any Casino games.

 

Bonus Bet funds are eligible to be wagered in line with all the following requirements (“Bonus Bet Requirements”) in order to be converted to withdrawable real cash:

  • Bonus Bet funds can be redeemed on any market(s).
  • Bonus Bets may only be redeemed one at a time.
  • Winnings will automatically convert to real cash upon bet settlement. 
  • Bonus Bets cannot be used on any Casino games.

 

Cancellation

To cancel participation in this or any promotion, contact customer support by email at support@thescore.bet with your cancellation request. Upon cancellation, you may withdraw any funds you have deposited into your account without restriction. However, any bonus funds in your account must be converted to cash before it may be withdrawn.

 

Gambling Problem?

  • Colorado, Kentucky, Michigan, Missouri, New Jersey, & Pennsylvania: If you or someone you know has a gambling problem, help is available. Call 1-800-GAMBLER.

  • Kansas: Gambling problem? Getting help is your best bet. Call 1-800-522-4700.
